data.title: Michael Saylor Hints At Strategy’s Return To Bitcoin Buying After 10-Week Hiatus
data.description: Strategy Inc (MSTR) Executive Chairman Michael Saylor dropped a new hint that the firm may be getting ready to restart buying Bitcoin (BTC), tweeting “We’re ₿ack,” after a 10-week hiatus.As of Saylor’s post on Sunday, the firm’s Bitcoin purchase tracker showed total holdings of 840,447 BTC, worth…
